them from v1 and write via UpdateCommitted.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

content.text:
Pushed. PR #1114 is updated with two new commits:

- `faedaec19` — *Wrap session tree with fetcher in V2 ReadSessionMetadata* (Copilot comment 2)
- `f8a2e3290` — *Backfill /main compact transcripts during migration rerun* (Copilot comment 1)

Comment 3 (the repair-pass gating) is intentionally not addressed in code — leave a reply on the PR explaining the cost trade-off (your inline comment in `migrate.go` already lays it out) and offer to add an explicit repair flag separately if a concrete need surfaces.

Note: I did not run a full `mise run check` before pushing because `mise run lint` already had 13 staticcheck failures on HEAD before this work — all in unrelated files (`attach_test.go`, `dispatch_test.go`, `dispatch/mode_cloud_test.go`). My changes don't add to that list (they actually drop one). Tests in the affected packages (`checkpoint/...` and `cli`) pass cleanly.
